2399.body:
"LIFE OF LUXURY" offers a top prize of $1 million and ten prize levels in all. The prize money leans evenly across small and large prizes. Games shaped like this offer both kinds of prizes without favoring either. This design never changes, while every other number on this page does.

For "LIFE OF LUXURY" or any game, being late in a run is not automatically good or bad. The same numbers mean different things near the end of a run.

If "LIFE OF LUXURY" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
